lines.text: People only tell you the truth when it's safe to.
Most anonymous forms still know who answered. They just promise not to look.
Start from a template, choose exactly who can respond, and share one link.
Your team proves they're invited with a one-time code. Then they answer.
Before anything leaves the browser, Noon blinds it.
The server signs what it can't read. So the answer arrives with proof, but no name.
You see who responded, and what they said. Never who said what.
Free to start, and open source.
lines.caption: Free to start, and open source.
